## Ballpark Estimate Guidelines
- **Small Town Yard (Under 0.25 Acre):** ~$40–$55 per weekly mowing visit
- **Standard Suburb Lot (0.25 – 0.5 Acre):** ~$55–$75 per weekly mowing visit
- **Large / Corner Lot (0.5 – 1.0 Acre):** ~$75–$110 per weekly mowing visit
- **Acreage / Estate (1.0 – 2+ Acres):** ~$110–$185+ per mowing visit
- **Add-On & Winter Project Services:** Rolled longleaf pine straw & mulch, fall & winter leaf removal, flowerbed weeding & shrub/privacy tree planting, bush & hedge sculpting, pond bank & fence-line clearing, bush hogging, and trailer junk/debris haul-away. Free exact estimates provided by calling or texting (601) 906-1281.
